lines.beaver_en: Hello. My camera suddenly won't turn on.
lines.learner: 네, 배터리를 비롯해서 부품을 다 확인할게요.
lines.en: Okay, I'll check all the parts, including the battery.
lines.roman: ne, baeteorireul birotaeseo bupumeul da hwaginhalkkeyo.

lines.beaver_en: It's a camera for news coverage. I knocked it over yesterday.
lines.en: After you knocked it over, was there any strange vibration?

lines.beaver: 네, 켤 때 많이 떨렸어요. 오래 걸려요?
lines.beaver_en: Yes, it shook a lot when I turned it on. Will it take long?
lines.beaver_roman: ne, kyeol ttae mani tteollyeosseoyo. orae geollyeoyo?
lines.learner: 내부 부품을 바꾸면 두어 시간 걸릴 거예요.
lines.en: If I replace the inner parts, it'll take about two hours.
lines.roman: naebu bupumeul bakkumyeon dueo sigan geollil kkeoyeyo.

lines.beaver_en: That's a relief. I have a shoot at the studio today.
lines.en: What kind of video are you shooting?

lines.beaver: 새 프로그램 예고 영상이에요. 시청률이 중요해요.
lines.beaver_en: It's a preview for a new show. Ratings matter a lot.
lines.beaver_roman: sae peurogeuraem yego yeongsangieyo. sicheongnyuri jungyohaeyo.
lines.en: Then I'd better hurry. I'll check the power button too.

lines.beaver: 카메라 안에 영상 자료가 많아요. 자료는 안전한가요?
lines.beaver_en: There's a lot of footage in the camera. Is my data safe?
lines.beaver_roman: kamera ane yeongsang jaryoga manayo. jaryoneun anjeonhangayo?
lines.learner: 네, 보안 때문에 사용자 자료는 열어 보지 않아요.
lines.en: Yes, for security we never open users' data.
lines.roman: ne, boan ttaemune sayongja jaryoneun yeoreo boji anayo.

lines.beaver: 안심이 되네요. 혹시 제가 조작을 잘못한 걸까요?
lines.beaver_en: That's reassuring. Did I maybe operate it wrong?
lines.beaver_roman: ansimi doeneyo. hoksi jega jojageul jalmotan geolkkayo?
lines.learner: 아니요, 떨어질 때 부품이 손상된 것 같아요.
lines.en: No, it seems a part got damaged when it fell.
lines.roman: aniyo, tteoreojil ttae bupumi sonsangdoen geot gatayo.

lines.beaver: 그렇군요. 요즘 카메라는 기술이 정말 좋던데요.
lines.beaver_en: I see. Camera technology is really good these days.
lines.beaver_roman: geureokunyo. yojeum kameraneun gisuri jeongmal joteondeyo.
lines.en: Yes, even smartphone cameras are good these days.

lines.beaver: 맞아요. 요즘은 시청자도 직접 영상을 만들어요.
lines.beaver_en: Right. Nowadays even viewers make their own videos.
lines.beaver_roman: majayo. yojeumeun sicheongjado jikjeop yeongsangeul mandeureoyo.
lines.en: That's why there are so many camera ads.

lines.beaver: 그럼 두 시간 뒤에 다시 올게요. 수고하세요.
lines.beaver_en: Then I'll come back in two hours. Thanks for your work.
lines.beaver_roman: geureom du sigan dwie dasi olkkeyo. sugohaseyo.
lines.learner: 네, 다 고치면 전화드릴게요. 안녕히 가세요.
lines.en: Sure, I'll call you when it's fixed. Goodbye.
lines.roman: ne, da gochimyeon jeonhwadeurilkkeyo. annyeonghi gaseyo.
